dclm.method: paired item bootstrap within each task; multinomial counts of identical paired rows

dclm.uncertainty: benchmark items only; does not cover training seeds
dclm.drop_sign: parent minus student; positive is worse after healing
dclm.direct_sign: X72 student minus P300 student; positive is higher X72 accuracy
